title: skills: relationships.md smart-default sentence says a lone file/image field tips inline edit to form; it takes two or more
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYo86w1wqy2z2fMrryr

## What

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, "Inline-edit form factor", teaches the smart default (what an omitted `inlineEdit` picks) as: picks `form` "when the child has rich/form-only fields (textarea, file, image, json, location…) or more than ~8 editable fields, else `grid`".

The code splits that list in two. In `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts` on main `6cfd04d9e2`:

- `FORM_ONLY_TYPES` (`textarea`, `richtext`, `html`, `markdown`, `rich-text`, `json`, `location`, `address`): a single one tips to `form`.
- `GRID_CAPABLE_RICH_TYPES` (`file`, `image`, `avatar`): "A LONE one no longer forces a per-row form — 'attach a receipt per line' stays a grid" (#2360). They count toward `RICH_FIELD_FORM_THRESHOLD = 2`, so two or more tip to `form`.
- More than `SMART_FORM_FIELD_THRESHOLD = 8` editable fields tips to `form`.

An agent following the skill expects a line-item child with one receipt `file` field to open per-row forms, and may set `inlineEdit: 'form'` explicitly where the grid was wanted, or explain the grid it gets as a bug.

Found by the contract reviewer of PR #37170 (records 7149242271 and 7149350343, "not a finding on this diff, pre-existing on main").

## Expected

- The smart-default sentence names the two groups as the code does: one form-only type (textarea, rich text, json, location, address…) tips to `form`; `file` / `image` / `avatar` stay in the grid alone and tip at two or more; more than ~8 editable fields tips to `form`.
- Fewest words; pay any added bytes by same-file cuts (token ratchet, no ceiling raise).
- Read the code on main for every fact. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; `skills/**` is governed — the low-risk skills arm if it qualifies, else the seat.

Blocked-by: #37042

Responsibility: `the published skill text skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md (objectstack-ai/objectstack) says a lone file or image field tips the inline-edit smart default to form | resolveInlineMode's GRID_CAPABLE_RICH_TYPES and RICH_FIELD_FORM_THRESHOLD (#2360) | every agent that installs objectstack-data and reasons about the default form factor of a line-item child`
